verdict.rationale: Cactus is an on-device inference engine, so cold-start latency and runtime binary size are fair questions to ask of it. However, the evidence pack documents neither startup time nor runtime footprint. The closest items are a 16.9 MB model file, a `cactus benchmark` command and community praise for inference speed, but these describe model size, a measurement tool and throughput, not fast cold start from a lightweight runtime.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can get a fast cold start from a lightweight runtime binary instead of waiting seconds before inference begins
